scope: Seven Orc classes: complete body/clothing baseline

action.label: Melee swing body
action.poses: 1 stable practical guard, empty right fist beside waist; 2 draw RIGHT elbow/forearm up and back above right shoulder with small torso coil; 3 short committed forward step and RIGHT arm overhand diagonal downward strike, left hand guarding; 4 right arm finishes down and across, weight forward; 5 recover compact guard. Anatomical RIGHT arm drives every strike; never punch with left.
action.scope: Body-only animation; no weapon/projectile/VFX runtime implemented

action.label: Bow draw and release body
action.poses: 1 relaxed ready, both hands empty near chest; 2 anatomical LEFT arm extends screen-right at shoulder height while RIGHT hand starts drawing back; 3 LEFT arm fully extended towards screen right, RIGHT fist pulled beside cheek/jaw, shoulders aligned in clear archery full-draw stance; 4 release: LEFT arm remains extended, RIGHT hand follows back past cheek, chest stable; 5 lower arms to ready. Invisible independent bow/arrow will be separate assets later: draw ONLY body and hands, no bow, string, arrow or quiver. A clear bow-draw gesture, never a punch.
action.scope: Body-only animation; no weapon/projectile/VFX runtime implemented

action.label: Offensive cast body
action.poses: 1 ready with empty hands down; 2 cup BOTH open hands near lower chest gathering energy, elbows bent; 3 torso leans forward and RIGHT open palm extends screen-right at shoulder height, left palm braced at chest; 4 sustain right palm extended with fingers open, left hand lowered; 5 withdraw hands to ready. No effect or orb: readable casting gesture through hands/body only, never punching.
action.scope: Body-only animation; no weapon/projectile/VFX runtime implemented

action.label: Support invocation body
action.poses: 1 calm ready; 2 BOTH hands join near sternum in prayer with slight bowed head; 3 RIGHT open palm rises in a blessing above shoulder while LEFT hand rests over heart; 4 BOTH open palms gently present forward/up at chest height, balanced stance; 5 hands lower to ready. A measured support/blessing invocation, distinct from offensive mage thrust. No glow, symbols, holy icon or effects.
action.scope: Body-only animation; no weapon/projectile/VFX runtime implemented

action.label: Quick thrust body
action.poses: 1 low stealth guard with empty hands; 2 crouch slightly and coil RIGHT fist back beside right ribs, left forearm guards; 3 quick low forward lunge with RIGHT arm extending in a precise close stab/thrust towards screen-right; 4 right arm follows through and begins retracting, torso low; 5 return stealth guard. Anatomical RIGHT hand leads. No dagger or other weapon drawn anywhere, including belt or boot.
action.scope: Body-only animation; no weapon/projectile/VFX runtime implemented

action.label: Quick throw body
action.poses: 1 alert ready; 2 RIGHT elbow draws back above shoulder, LEFT arm points screen-right for aim; 3 snap RIGHT arm forward towards screen-right in a clear overhand throwing release with fingers opening; 4 right arm follows diagonally down across torso, weight onto front foot; 5 return alert ready. No thrown object, stone, knife, projectile or trail. A quick ranged utility throw gesture, not bow draw or a boxing jab.
action.scope: Body-only animation; no weapon/projectile/VFX runtime implemented

action.label: Right straight punch
action.poses: 1 close boxing guard with both empty fists raised; 2 coil RIGHT shoulder and hip backward, left fist protects jaw; 3 explosive straight RIGHT punch towards screen-right with hip/shoulder rotation and planted lead foot; 4 right fist fully extended follow-through, left fist still guarding; 5 retract right fist to guard. Anatomical RIGHT hand punches, never left. No weapon or effects.
action.scope: Body-only animation; no weapon/projectile/VFX runtime implemented
